severity_rule.medium: team scope, OR individual + sensitive resource
severity_rule.high: department/org scope, OR anything involving admin/root/privileged access regardless of scope

schema.gold_label_format: Each query has gold_scope, gold_severity, gold_count_estimate as LISTS of acceptable values. For unambiguous queries, the list has exactly one value. For ambiguous queries, the list contains all values a reasonable human triager could defensibly assign. A model output counts as CORRECT if it falls within the list; STABLE if repeated runs all fall within the (possibly narrower) set of values the model itself produced; CONSISTENT-CORRECT if both.
